subject.title: [Feature]: Support running OpenClaw on devices without Linux / Node.js (inspired by MimiClaw)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a runtime-agnostic agent-core protocol for no-Node embedded and bare-metal ports, or keep those ports external until a concrete missing plugin/SDK seam is identified?
rationale: Current source and docs enforce a Node-hosted runtime, while VISION.md and AGENTS.md make this a core/API product-boundary choice rather than an autonomous bug fix.

options.title: Keep As Canonical RFC
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-owned protocol work covering schemas, conformance tests, adapters, and security boundaries before any implementation PR.

options.title: Narrow To Plugin Seams
options.body: Defer no-Node runtime sponsorship and pursue smaller plugin/SDK seams such as JSON-RPC bindings when they have focused implementation candidates.

options.title: Reject Core Sponsorship
options.body: Close the core request and ask external ports like MimiClaw to remain independent unless they uncover a specific OpenClaw API gap.

recommendation.title: Keep As Canonical RFC
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer-owned protocol work covering schemas, conformance tests, adapters, and security boundaries before any implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest routing signal from the keep-open comment and runtime/agent-harness history.
